newsitem.title: JAPAN: Chugai and Merck to launch drug venture in Japan.
newsitem.headline: Chugai and Merck to launch drug venture in Japan.

text.p: Japan's Chugai Pharmaceutical Co Ltd and Merck and Co Inc of the United States said on Wednesday that they have agreed to launch a joint venture to make and market over-the-counter drugs in Japan.
The new firm, Chugai MSD Co Ltd, is expected to start operating as early as April next year, the companies said in a joint statement. Its starting capital is set at 2.5 billion yen.
Chugai will hold 70 percent of the joint venture, and Merck will own the rest.
